en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a dense religious procession moving through a town square. Clergy and robed participants walk in formation around a richly decorated reliquary carried on poles, with a statue and banners visible. Large crowds line both sides of the street in front of Flemish-style gabled buildings. Printed captions in French appear under the image, identifying the scene as the Procession of the Holy Blood in Bruges with English pilgrims carrying a relic of St Thomas of Canterbury, and crediting the phototype printer in Antwerp.
